races.name: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Vicki Vale
runners_data.note: Front-running style with 544 days off makes fitness a major concern despite her early speed advantage.
runners_data.comment: Absent since her fourth at Ludlow in October 2024; entitled to need this outing
runners_data.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner when trained by Dan Sketon, but absent since her fourth at Ludlow (2m5f, good) for this stable in October 2024 and entitled to benefit from this outing.

runners_data.name: Mermaids Cave
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to expected pace, amateur jockey Mr Murphy adds 7lb claim benefit.
runners_data.comment: Seven hurdle wins; ran poorly last time but has slipped to a very good mark
runners_data.spotlight: 7-23 over hurdles, including a good-ground C&D win; beaten favourite in plating company two starts and pulled up in a subsequent handicap, but has slipped to a very good mark and can't be ruled out.

runners_data.name: Bitsnbuckles
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist from powerful Olly Murphy stable with Tom Hutsby's 10lb claim reducing his burden significantly.
runners_data.comment: Shade disappointing last time but earlier Southwell win was career-best form
runners_data.spotlight: Slightly disappointing when only fourth on his latest outing, but posted career-best form when winning readily by over 6l at Southwell (2m4f, good to soft) two starts ago and has an obvious claims if back at that level.

runners_data.name: Shotgun Rider
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who raced too freely last time but has strong form behind useful rivals on first two starts.
runners_data.comment: Spoiled chance by racing too freely on h'cap debut; first two hurdle runs were promising
runners_data.spotlight: Good-ground Irish point winner who was second behind useful rivals on first two hurdling starts (2m4f/2m2f); well beaten after racing too freely on last month's handicap debut but remains open to improvement if he settles better here.

runners_data.name: Coolkatie
runners_data.note: Prominent style with Harry Skelton booking suggests confidence after promising fall at Warwick before handicap debut.
runners_data.comment: Well held on handicap debut but the ground was heavy; still has potential
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed mare who was set to be placed at least before last-flight fall in Warwick novice (2m5f, good to soft) in December; safely held on handicap debut at Exeter (2m, heavy) in February, but ought to be better suited by today's trip-and-ground combination; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Livano Bello
runners_data.note: Prominent but exposed and winless over hurdles, though recent placed efforts show consistent level.
runners_data.comment: 0-11 over hurdles but fairly consistent this season; probably won't be far away
runners_data.spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles and looks exposed, but was placed three consecutive times towards end of 2025 (2m4f-2m5f) and gave another good account when close third of five at Market Rasen (2m2f) three weeks ago; probably won't be far away.

runners_data.name: Painted Wolf
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who showed marked improvement when close second at this course and distance last month.
runners_data.comment: 0-5 over hurdles but was close second of four behind progressive rival over C&D last month
runners_data.spotlight: 0-5 over hurdles but left disappointing handicap debut behind when close second of four behind a progressive rival over C&D (good to soft) last month, and his Irish point form suggests he'll be fine on this faster ground.

races.paceDynamic: Vicki Vale leads with Shotgun Rider, Coolkatie, and Livano Bello tracking prominently, while hold-up horses Mermaids Cave, Bitsnbuckles, and Painted Wolf settle behind. The sustained pace from multiple prominent runners will create a searching gallop over this 2m4f trip on good ground. The early tempo should be honest but not suicidal, with the real race beginning after the final hurdle when the hold-up brigade unleash their finishing kicks. This pace setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can capitalise on the sustained gallop by delivering late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners maintain a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the front-runners over the final half-mile, allowing the closers to pick up the pieces. Mermaids Cave, Bitsnbuckles, and Painted Wolf are perfectly positioned to exploit tired leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Success
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can dictate fractions and kick clear
scenarios.body: A horse like Coolkatie or Shotgun Rider could steal a march by controlling the tempo and having enough left for a decisive move. The hold-up horses may find themselves with too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Collapse and Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong and main contenders tire
scenarios.body: The searching gallop could undo the favourites, allowing an outsider to pick up the pieces late. Livano Bello or Painted Wolf could benefit from others' misfortune despite their own limitations.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Vicki Vale gets an uncontested lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: Despite her long absence, she could use her front-running style to maximum advantage if unopposed early. The hold-up horses would need to work harder to reach her, potentially compromising their finishing kicks.

watchPoints.text: Vicki Vale's fitness after 544 days off could see her fade dramatically if she leads into the straight
Shotgun Rider's tendency to race too freely may repeat under pressure in a strongly-run contest
Mermaids Cave's amateur rider Mr Murphy managing the tactical battle against experienced professional jockeys
Bitsnbuckles and Painted Wolf both need the pace to develop for their hold-up styles to be effective
Coolkatie's jumping under pressure after her last-flight fall at Warwick when well-placed

races.name: Aldiss Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Cotton Socks
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with recent hurdle form but 22 days off, fitted with hood suggesting concentration issues
runners_data.comment: Placed in two junior bumpers; remote when third on recent hurdle debut; more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two junior bumpers towards end of last year (good to soft/soft), but was remote when third on hurdling debut at Market Rasen (2m, good to soft) and needs to improve to trouble an on-song Tralee Girl.

runners_data.name: Tralee Girl
runners_data.note: Class horse with Listed hurdle form but 72 days since last run, prominent style suits if fitness holds
runners_data.comment: Placed in two Listed hurdles in the autumn and very much the one to beat here
runners_data.spotlight: Fair Flat racer who was placed in Listed races at Wetherby (2m, good) and Newbury (2m, soft) on her first two hurdling starts; below that form in another Listed race in January but still very much the one to beat here.

runners_data.name: Subtle Glance
runners_data.note: Unproven in both bumpers, hurdling debut with refitted hood makes this a watching brief only
runners_data.comment: Well down the field in both bumpers and can only be watched on this hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Well down the field in both bumpers and can only be watched on this hurdling debut; hood (worn on debut) refitted.

runners_data.name: Winston's Oath
runners_data.note: Moderate bumper form confirmed when behind Cotton Socks last time, needs significant improvement
runners_data.comment: Showed only minor promise in three bumpers and was well beaten on hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Showed only minor promise in his three bumpers and was behind Cotton Socks when well-beaten sixth on recent hurdling debut at Market Rasen.

runners_data.name: Argentum
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making hurdle debut after poor Flat form, 150-1 last time suggests low expectations
runners_data.comment: Placed in low-grade Flat handicaps last year but well beaten on recent hurdle debut
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in low-grade Flat handicaps at around 1m4f last year, but well beaten (albeit in deeper race than this) when 150-1 for recent hurdling debut at Huntingdon (2m, good).

runners_data.name: Whatcombe
runners_data.note: Front runner with fade-in-finish weakness, 154 days off after disappointing Flat career for previous yard
runners_data.comment: Became very disappointing on the Flat and has a lot to prove on hurdling debut
runners_data.spotlight: Became very disappointing on the Flat for Paul and Oliver Cole and was well beaten on both starts for this stable in the autumn (1m6f/1m4f; wore cheekpieces); has a lot to prove on hurdling debut; no headgear this time.

runners_data.name: Fitzroy Gardens
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with AW win in Ireland, cheekpieces off after improved third last time suggests progress
runners_data.comment: Flat winner; second hurdle run was much better than her debut; can collect a minor prize
runners_data.spotlight: Won on the AW in Ireland in the autumn (1m4f; RPR 76) and bettered inauspicious stable/hurdle debut (wore cheekpieces) when third of eight (albeit well held) at Catterick (1m7f, good; blinkers refitted) last month; can collect another minor prize here.

races.paceDynamic: Whatcombe leads the early pace given his front-running tendencies, though his fade-in-finish profile suggests he'll weaken approaching the final hurdle. Cotton Socks, Tralee Girl, Winston's Oath and Fitzroy Gardens will settle prominently behind, creating a steady gallop rather than genuine pressure early. The lack of confirmed pacesetting pressure means this becomes a sprint finish from the last hurdle, heavily favouring horses with finishing kick over pure speed. This race shape clearly benefits hold-up horses and those with tactical speed who can quicken late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Whatcombe sets uncontested fractions and fades predictably from two out
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows class horses to wind up late, with Tralee Girl's superior rating and finishing speed proving decisive. Her Listed-class form trumps modest opposition when given racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Genuine Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Cotton Socks or Winston's Oath press Whatcombe from flagfall creating sustained pace
scenarios.body: The honest gallop suits horses who can travel and quicken, with Tralee Girl's class again telling but Cotton Socks benefiting from the stronger test. Both have shown ability to handle tempo changes.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners hesitate behind the fading Whatcombe, creating stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The tactical race becomes a lottery where inexperienced horses struggle with pace judgment, potentially suiting Argentum's hold-up style. His Flat background helps in scrappy finishes where positioning matters most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Whatcombe stops completely early and no horse takes up running, creating crawling fractions
scenarios.body: The lack of any pace turns this into a pure sprint finish where raw speed matters most over stamina. Cotton Socks' recent hurdle experience gives him advantage in chaotic circumstances over classier but rustier rivals.

watchPoints.text: Tralee Girl carries significant market confidence despite 72-day absence, any drift suggests fitness concerns
Whatcombe's front-running role is crucial given his fade profile, early weakness changes entire race dynamic completely
Cotton Socks and Winston's Oath met recently at Market Rasen with clear form line to assess improvement
Subtle Glance is a complete unknown quantity on hurdle debut, refitted hood suggests ongoing issues
Multiple runners carry headgear changes or applications indicating trainer concerns about attitude or focus

races.name: Aldiss "Chasing Excellence" Novices' Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Kilaro
runners_data.note: Front runner making chase debut after bumper success but Tim Easterby's poor 14-day record (0/11) raises immediate concerns about readiness.
runners_data.comment: Point/bumper winner; makes chasing debut having bypassed hurdles; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Won good-ground maiden point in November and followed up in good style in Musselburgh bumper (good to soft) on rules debut in December; not discredited when third in quite valuable Kelso bumper (good to soft; hooded) last month and Tim Easterby is evidently very keen to launch his chasing career.

runners_data.name: Sonigino
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist whose class advantage is significant but the 64-day absence and inconsistent recent form creates uncertainty about current condition.
runners_data.comment: Very useful hurdler; showed form on only one of three starts this season; chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful hurdler with 6-22 strike-rate; has shown his form on only one of three starts since returning from a long absence this season, when close third at Sandown (2m4f, good) two starts ago, but has obvious claims if on song for this chasing debut.

runners_data.name: Walking On Air
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up in trip after Doncaster third but the switch from 3m+ back to 2m5f may not suit his stamina-laden profile.
runners_data.comment: Very useful on his good days but 0-10 over fences and very inconsistent
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful on his good days, the latest when third in Great Yorkshire Chase at Doncaster (3m, soft; first-time cheekpieces) in January; subsequent 3m6f Cheltenham Festival defeat can be excused and he'll be fine on the forecast good ground here, but he's 0-10 over fences and very inconsistent.

races.paceDynamic: Kilaro will take them along from the front in this small field, with Walking On Air likely to sit handy in second while Sonigino tracks from the rear. With only three runners and Kilaro as the sole confirmed front runner, the pace will be steady and controlled rather than testing. The lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a tactical affair where stamina and jumping accuracy become paramount. This moderate gallop strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, giving Sonigino's patient style the clearest tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sonigino Times Run Perfectly
scenarios.trigger: If Sonigino jumps cleanly and Gingell delivers his typical well-timed challenge from the rear.
scenarios.body: The modest pace plays directly into the hold-up horse's hands as Kilaro and Walking On Air serve as sitting ducks up front. Sonigino's class advantage shines through when the race develops into a pure test of ability rather than tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Kilaro Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If the front runner maintains a stronger gallop than expected and his jumping holds up under pressure.
scenarios.body: Walking On Air gets first crack at the leader but Kilaro's stamina proves superior in the closing stages. The lack of early pressure allows the leader to conserve energy for a decisive move when challenged.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Walking On Air Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runner can pressure Kilaro early while staying clear of Sonigino's late charge.
scenarios.body: The tactical position proves perfect as Walking On Air can dictate when to make his move while keeping tabs on the leader. His recent Cheltenham form suggests the step up in trip suits despite the different demands.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Decides Contest
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make significant jumping errors that reshape the race dynamics.
scenarios.body: The steady pace becomes irrelevant as fluency at the obstacles determines the outcome rather than tactical positioning. The horse who jumps most accurately inherits a decisive advantage regardless of running style.

watchPoints.text: Watch Kilaro's jumping technique closely as novice chasers often struggle with fluency on debut over fences.
Monitor Sonigino's early positioning as Gingell needs to keep him close enough to strike in such a small field.
Watch for any market moves on Walking On Air as the trip reduction could expose stamina limitations despite recent promise.
Observe the early pace as Kilaro may go too fast if feeling pressure from Walking On Air tracking him.
Watch the ground conditions as any softening would significantly favour Sonigino's proven soft ground form.

races.name: Cecil & Sheila Buttifant Memorial Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Best Women
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who needs luck in running but has solid recent form and Kielan Woods' 7lb claim helps her chances significantly

runners_data.name: Four Decades
runners_data.note: Prominent runner perfectly placed to exploit tactical scenario but T Ellis has poor 0/9 record in last 14 days
runners_data.comment: Showed promise in 2m Kempton maiden in February and is bred for this much longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in latest qualifying race (raced too freely) but her midfield finish at Kempton (2m, good to soft) two starts ago was promising, and her pedigree suggests she'll be suited by this hike up in trip on her handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Callmesusie
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from a break with Louise Allan having a perfect 1/1 strike rate recently

runners_data.name: Abbey Law
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse but showed good form winning at Ludlow and handles good going conditions well

runners_data.name: Annie Nail
runners_data.note: Inconsistent hold-up mare with 7lb claimer but 64 days since last run may have dulled her edge
runners_data.comment: Far too inconsistent to rely upon but runs this track well and enters calculations
runners_data.spotlight: Won a chase here (2m5f, good) last May and returned to form with 66-1 second in soft-ground C&D hurdle in December; safely held twice since and too inconsistent to rely upon, but still features prominently in calculations.

races.paceDynamic: Four Decades is the only confirmed front runner in this small field and will control the tempo from the outset. With four hold-up horses behind her, she'll get an uncontested lead and can dictate fractions without pressure. The race will develop into a waiting game as Best Women, Abbey Law, Callmesusie and Annie Nail all need to be produced late. This race shape strongly favours the pace-setter Four Decades, who can exploit the tactical disadvantage of multiple closers bunched together in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Four Decades gets an easy lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The prominent runner controls every call without pressure and has enough left to repel late challenges. Multiple hold-up horses get in each other's way in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Closer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Best Women or Annie Nail get clear running late
scenarios.body: One hold-up horse finds the perfect passage through traffic while Four Decades weakens from her solo effort. Class tells in the final 100 yards.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Four Decades goes too fast early like at Kempton
scenarios.body: The leader burns out from over-racing and multiple closers sweep past in the straight. Abbey Law's recent Ludlow win suggests she's improving.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Result
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite Four Decades falls or makes an error
scenarios.body: Callmesusie or another outsider capitalizes on chaos to spring a surprise. The small field creates opportunities for unconsidered runners.

watchPoints.text: Four Decades racing too keenly early like her last run at Kempton where she went too fast and weakened
Best Women getting trapped behind horses in the straight as multiple hold-up runners converge simultaneously
Abbey Law's jumping under pressure as she steps up in class from her Ludlow maiden hurdle success
Annie Nail's fitness levels after 64 days off the track with inexperienced 7lb claimer Oscar Palmer aboard
Callmesusie's jumping rhythm returning from her 24-day break having pulled up in her penultimate start

races.name: Watch On Racing TV Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Cloudy Wednesday
runners_data.note: Natural leader with three course wins who should control the tempo from the front, returning to his favourite venue after decent Huntingdon efforts
runners_data.comment: Won the last two editions of this race and returns here after two good runs last month
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time course winner, including last two editions of this race (both on good ground); returned from layoff with two pretty good efforts at Huntingdon (2m7f/2m4f) last month and commands respect back here.

runners_data.name: Brother Boris
runners_data.note: Front-runner completing Fakenham hat-trick but his recent wins came in weak two-finisher contests, may press too hard early
runners_data.comment: Bids for course hat-trick after two wide-margin wins in two-finisher events
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner who bids to complete a Fakenham hat-trick after two wide-margin wins in two-finisher contests this year (3m5f, soft/3m, good to soft); the value of his form is tricky to evaluate and today's faster ground may not be ideal but, nevertheless, another bold bid seems likely.

runners_data.name: Reforme
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 97 days off, fortunate last win but consistent at this level when fit
runners_data.comment: Shade fortunate to win over C&D in October but still considered
runners_data.spotlight: Probably fortunate to win off today's mark over C&D (good to soft; leader fell at final fence) in October, but that was still a good effort and his next two runs were respectable; contender if tuned up after 97-day break.

runners_data.name: Another Mystery
runners_data.note: Sits prominent, drops 10lbs from hurdles mark but poor chasing strike-rate remains a concern despite class claims
runners_data.comment: Second over hurdles here last spring but this year's point form is uninspiring
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up over hurdles here (2m4f, good; first-time blinkers) on latest rules start last June and competes off a 10lb lower mark today, but his chasing strike-rate is 0-11 and this year's point form is uninspiring.

runners_data.name: Crac De Megaudais
runners_data.note: Genuine hold-up horse with course hurdles win but badly out of form in recent chases, needs significant revival
runners_data.comment: Course winner over hurdles last season but well beaten in his last three chases
runners_data.spotlight: Won by 12l over hurdles here (2m4f, good) last season but well beaten in his last three chases, most recently when back here (2m5f) in January; needs a revival on this first attempt at 3m.

races.paceDynamic: Cloudy Wednesday will set a measured gallop from the front, with Brother Boris likely to track closely given his front-running tendencies. The pace should be sustainable rather than punishing with these two natural leaders, creating a tactical battle where positioning matters more than pure speed. Reforme and Another Mystery will sit prominent, while Crac De Megaudais drops in last from his hold-up position. This setup favours horses who can travel well in the first three and have the tactical speed to respond when the tempo lifts from the home turn.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Cloudy Wednesday Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Cloudy Wednesday gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: The course specialist can employ kick-and-go tactics turning for home, using local knowledge to time his effort perfectly. Brother Boris may track too closely and compromise his own finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Brother Boris Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Boris applies early pressure or disputes the lead with Cloudy Wednesday
scenarios.body: The increased pace will set up the race for a closer with tactical speed from off the leaders. Reforme can benefit from the stronger gallop having shown good finishing kicks previously.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders tire from the second-last fence onwards
scenarios.body: Reforme and Another Mystery can capitalize on their handy positions without having done the donkey work. The 97-day break may tell on Reforme, giving Another Mystery the edge despite the higher weight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Crac De Megaudais Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up horse gets the perfect setup to unleash his proven finishing kick. However, his recent chase form suggests this revival scenario remains unlikely.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Brother Boris disputes the early lead with Cloudy Wednesday as both are natural front-runners who could compromise each other
Monitor Reforme's jumping early after 97 days off the track, especially as trainer Gretton has moderate strike-rate recently
Check if Crac De Megaudais can travel kindly in rear early, as his recent efforts suggest he may struggle to keep up
Watch Another Mystery's jumping fences as she returns from hurdles having shown inconsistent chasing form previously
Observe if Cloudy Wednesday can dictate fractions like in his previous course victories, particularly through the back straight

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Mares' Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Milliedram
runners_data.comment: Interesting pedigree, but stable not known for bumper winners
runners_data.spotlight: £1,500 3yo; ninth foal; half-sister to winners Gaitway (bumper/2m hurdle), Diamond Gait (bumper/2m hurdle) and Commander Miller (2m3f hurdle); dam 7f 2yo winner, half-sister to smart Flat/useful hurdle winner Bold Gait; interesting pedigree, but stable not known for bumper winners.

runners_data.name: Crescendo Lady
runners_data.comment: Fifth foal; sister to low-grade hurdle winner Libor Lad; limited appeal on paper
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; sister to low-grade hurdle winner Libor Lad; dam well beaten in bumpers; makes only limited appeal on paper.

runners_data.name: On The Cobbles
runners_data.comment: First foal from unraced sister to useful jumper Golden Taipan; yard very quiet in bumpers
runners_data.spotlight: First foal from unraced sister to useful jumper Golden Taipan; stable 0-42 in bumpers during the last five seasons.

runners_data.name: Hidden Fortune
runners_data.comment: Irish point winner; second on rules debut in November (form recently boosted by winner)
runners_data.spotlight: Stoutly bred mare who joined Dan Skelton after winning by 5l on Irish point debut (good to yielding) last spring; second of five in race that developed into a sprint at Market Rasen (good to soft) on rules debut in November; that form was boosted when the winner overcame a penalty last week, and this mare can probably improve if there's more emphasis on stamina here.

runners_data.name: L'Amandine
runners_data.comment: Third of 11 on debut at Ludlow in January; stable has excellent bumper record
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a French hurdle/chase winner; represents stable with excellent bumper strike-rate (25%) and kept on for third of 11 on debut at Ludlow (good to soft) in January; major player.

runners_data.name: Blue's Secret Gem
runners_data.comment: With a good stable and made quite encouraging debut when fourth of seven at Plumpton
runners_data.spotlight: With a good stable and made quite encouraging debut when fourth of seven at Plumpton (good to soft) last month; no surprise if she makes the necessary progress here.
